steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: Attention, all units. Lucilla is currently aiding a Church of the Deep cultist escape.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: She is to be regarded as an additional suspect in our pursuit.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: Her actions are proof enough. She intends to betray Ægir.
Twelve hours ago, Sea Patrol Station

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: You're saying that Anya schemed to lure the Seaborn occupying the volcanic power station to the city? Pft, what a sick joke. You're even calling her a cultist.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: This is no joking matter. The stolen Seaborn attractant pheromones, the timing of her going out to the sea... everything points towards Anya and her mentor. I hope you will cooperate with our investigation.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Our city moved so it could avoid Seaborn, right? You mean she tried to attract the Seaborn that weren't even chasing us? *sigh* Why would she even do that?

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: What is she doing now? Where is she?

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: Her vital signs were already gone by the time of the incident.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: She's... dead?
Sitting in the mezzanine of the transparent dome and quietly admiring the scenery outside, one may have the illusion of floating in the middle of the sea, surrounded by clear water.

steps.name: Anya
steps.text: *phew* I'm feeling a bit dizzy.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Want some neuro-stabilizers? I prepped some just for you. They inhibit the vertigo you get from a fear of heights. If you can't handle the bitterness, I also have—
Lucilla plucks some sweetener from her pocket with an exaggerated flourish, making Anya laugh.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: I heard your bioprobe got destroyed by the Seaborn again this morning, so I figured you'd be here after cleaning up that mess.

steps.name: Anya
steps.text: Yeah. Ran into a few of them while out reinstalling it.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Again...? How close were they this time?

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: This has been happening more and more often over the past six months, hasn't it? Every time you come here, you look absolutely exhausted.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Are you asleep?
Lucilla cranes her head over to have a look. Anya's head is resting on her shoulder as she quietly looks out at the clear waters outside the dome.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Tell me, Anya. Is the sea out there really that terrifying?

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: I... I work in the spot closest to the sea every day, but I've never seen them before.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: I only ever see the unending streams of legionnaires heading out, and you and your mentor doing your best to restore the ocean's ecology.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Sometimes, I think... What's the frontline really like? What price did you pay for the peace I see inside the dome?
Anya softly murmurs something. Lucilla can't help but lean over and look her in the eye.
Lucilla leaves the Sea Patrol station, still in a daze. She tries helplessly to contact Anya, over and over, but there is no response.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: What's this...?!

a.text: I am sure you have also gotten involved in the Sea Patrol's investigation, and they told you that Anya attempted to provoke the Seaborn from the power station into chasing our retreating city.
I have something important to tell you about her true cause of death.
Please come meet me immediately after receiving this message, for her sake.
As her friend, you wouldn't ignore this, would you?

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: (Anya's mentor... He was with her that day!)

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: *pant*—*pant*—

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Did we manage to shake them off?

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: *cough* At least I can't see any Sea Patrol uniforms...

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: You are really... All I said was that they were shadowing me, and you just took off... Aren't you scared of them branding you as my accomplice?

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: I just want to know the truth. Can't do that if you're arrested.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Tell me, is Anya really...?

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: She sacrificed herself, yes.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: We promised to see an exhibition together, but she suddenly stood me up to go out to sea with you. What did you two discover? Is she the reason why the Sea Patrol are tailing you?

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: They suspect I am a cultist of the Church of the Deep, but they have no proof.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Well, are you?

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: I am not fond of that label, and I do not believe in any doctrines as such. I merely believe what I believe.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: ...So, that's a 'yes.' What about... what about Anya?

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Anya. She was my greatest student, whether in academia, or in my approach towards the Seaborn. Did she not tell you anything?

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: They've stopped running. Keep your distance; let them think they shook us off.

steps.name: Sea Patroller
steps.text: I've identified the woman Pappus contacted: Lucilla, a dome maintenance worker with the Academy of Technology's Institute of Facility Management.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: I know her. We did our own investigation into her not too long ago. She said that even if she herself fell in with the Church, Anya would never fall.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: Tap into the closest camera. Let's hear what they're talking about.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: You're lying. You said you wanted to tell me the truth, but you're saying the same thing the Sea Patrol did—

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: 'She's a cultist; she led the Seaborn to the city.' Like her death was no surprise. Like she got what she deserved.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: So where's the difference? Wasn't there supposed to be some kind of hidden truth?

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Calm down, Lucilla. Lower your voice.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: I am calm. I'm the calmest person here in this ridiculous... whatever's-going-on!

spans.text: calm. I'm the calmest person here in this ridiculous... whatever's-going-on!

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: I sought you out because it must be you who realizes her truest desire. Only you can do this.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: I want you to take Anya's remains from the reef I concealed them in, and return them to the city. Once you see them, you will understand everything.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Her... remains?

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Alright, it's safer to discuss it in here.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: I know it's a shock, having to hear your close friend be referred to as 'remains.' But you must understand the heroic sacrifice she made to see her wish come true.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: You're saying this was all her own choice?

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: The conclusion she and I arrived at withstood countless refutations and proofs. Humanity is but a link in the ocean's food chain. If we do not wish to be at its lowest rung, we must evolve.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: And the very peak of evolution, the Seaborn, have thrown wide the gates for us.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Yet we refuse to partake in it, all for the sake of so-called 'human dignity.' Is that not arrogance? Is that not irresponsible towards the future of humanity? Is that not—

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Stop. 'Evolution,' 'arrogance'... I have no idea what the hell you're on about.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: *sigh* I understand your doubts. In truth, Anya had similar misgivings to my proposal at first.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: But as you now know, in the end she even snatched the pheromones from my hand to guide the Seaborn herself.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: If one is to take the reins of destiny for all humanity, then one must be suitably aware of the suffering and moral condemnation one is to shoulder. Does that not sound like the Anya you know?
Lucilla glares at the old man. She considers denying what she has heard, but all the facts ring true.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: You still haven't said what's going on with her remains.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Before she left, she promised me that even if the plan failed, she would bring back living Seaborn cells.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: I gave my all to retrieve her one remaining hand. What she promised me was still tightly in its grasp.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: As you know, there is no means of bringing it into the city. The dome does have entrances for cleaning robots, though, which should be exactly the size I need.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: All you need to do is put on a little show as a dome maintenance worker and make it past their checks.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Anya's last wish...

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: If this really is what she wanted... I just need to bring her home, right?

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Tell me which reef you hid her... remains in.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: (Anya and her wish were hidden in the reefs close to the power station...)

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: You must steel your mind, Lucilla. Considering it's been more than twenty-four hours since the incident, your friend's remains will be unrecognizable.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Don't worry. I just want to see it for myself. Her last wish.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: You mentioned during the investigation that you once harbored fallen thoughts, too. But you've made the right choice by reporting Pappus to us.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: I just don't think calling the Seaborn to attack the city sounds like something she'd wish for.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: Regardless, I still hope you'll reconsider our proposal. Pappus has gone into hiding. It'd be more efficient if you were able to lure him out.

steps.name: Sea Patroller
steps.text: We discovered a human hand within marker range. We're requesting an analysis from the technicians.
The Sea Patroller hands over a transparent vessel. A pale, waterlogged, and bloated arm rests within.
Lucilla does not lift her gaze from it.

steps.name: Sea Patroller
steps.text: Are you alright?
She is not. Her mind feels like it is tearing apart at the seams, blocking out all rationality. Lucilla stands rigid as a corpse herself, before she collects herself enough to speak.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: That's her hand, alright. We were always looking over the same control panel, tapping it now and then... I'd recognize her nails anywhere.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: Do you know what's in her hand?
Under the careful ministrations of the technician, a small, sealed jar for storing liquids is prised out from the hand's grasp.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: (That's...!)

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: (So that's what it was. I get it now. This little jar you were holding onto so tightly. This is your wish, Anya.)

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: ...You know, I've just made up my mind. I'll help you. I'll help you guys get Pappus out in the open.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: Five minutes until the meeting, Lucilla. Pappus could come out at any time. Stay close to the building. You're deviating from the route, and it'll be hard for us to show up promptly if anything happens.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: Lucilla?

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: No response. Everyone, prepare for non-compliance from her.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: Pappus has appeared.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Come with me, quick. The Sea Patrol knows about our plan. I'll help you escape.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: What? I need more details—

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: There's no time! Just run already!

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: I guess we were right to be worried.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: Attention, all units. Lucilla is currently aiding a Church of the Deep cultist escape.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: She is to be regarded as an additional suspect in our pursuit.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: Her actions are proof enough. She intends to betray Ægir.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: This is... the city's water circulation system?

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: The pipes are interlinked with the dome, so they fall under my purview as well. I've closed all the sluice gates that I can; should buy us some time.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: This isn't what we discussed, Lucilla.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Dome monitoring's more strict than usual while the city's moving. The inlets are the only places that don't get extra scrutiny. Thing is, one of us needs to squeeze in to intercept the thing.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Wait, let me consider this.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Why, worried about the risk? As Anya's esteemed teacher, surely you're as brave as she was?

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: With this sudden turn of affairs, can I still trust you, Lucilla?

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: We don't need to trust each other. You want your thing, I want to fulfill Anya's last wish. That's all.
Pappus looks Lucilla in the eyes and ponders for a brief moment.
If she had intended to betray him, she wouldn't be helping him flee. That would be ridiculously inefficient. He loosens up.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: When we met yesterday, your eyes were clouded with hesitation. But now, that's all cleared. I'm glad to see you make the right choice.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Sure, but we're short on time. You need to get into the pipe, now.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Now? But I'm not wearing any protective equipment.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Sorry, what was that? Anya grabbed the attractant pheromones from your hand without the slightest hesitation, and you're worried about a little thing like that?

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Quick, I've already opened the feeder gate! I can't keep it open for long, so just get in already!

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: But this is—!
Right as Pappus senses that something is off, a push to his back sends him tumbling straight into the pipe.
Lucilla closes the sewage gate. She looks into the air, her hands trembling slightly as they grasp the gate handle.
But after a moment, she snaps out of it, and smiles.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Gah! This stench! This isn't sewage, is it?!

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Where are you, Lucilla?

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Did you find anything down there?

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: The flow's too strong and the walls are slippery! I-I can't keep my balance! AHH!

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: You just gotta keep at it. Feel around in the water. This is for the sake of the city's future, remember?

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Why is there sewage in the city's water inlet pipes? Urp! Pah! Bluerghh...

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Oops, I forgot to mention, those are actually the inner circulatory pipes. They handle residue from algae fermentation. The water inlet pipes are incredibly important; no way they'd let you in.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: You tricked me, Lucilla! Why did you-! *vomits* Urgh... *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: ...Open the gate. Let me out.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Talk to me about Anya. What was the last thing she said to you?

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Geh... *cough*! How do you expect me to talk down here? I can't even breathe...

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Answer me, or we'll be here all day.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: I've already told you everything you needed.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Fine, if you really must know— Urgh! *cough* *cough*! After the Seaborn took over the power station, I realized this was my only chance. I had to lure them over, before the city had evacuated too far away.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: I was close to the power station before I noticed that Anya had rushed over as well. In her haste to head out to sea, she'd had no time to recharge her pod's power to full, something I only learned afterwards.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: We were right next to the station, and the Seaborn had already spotted us. We had no time to discuss things. We had to, at the very least, successfully release the pheromones and lure them to the city.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: And so, she snatched the pheromones from my hand and promised she would complete our mission, bidding me return to the city. I got into my own pod. Someone had to perform the backup plan, after all.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Her pod, however, ran out of power and was caught by the Seaborn. The last thing I heard through the comms was her saying, over and over again, that she would hold it tight. *cough* *cough* *cough*! Geh—

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Hold what tight?

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: She could only have meant the live Seaborn samples. Though we'd had significant disagreement over the backup plan I suggested, in that moment, we had a tacit understanding.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: I already asked the Sea Patrol to find her remains.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: ...You told on me to the Sea Patrol? Lucilla, do... do you really understand Anya?

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Heh. Right. You were always hiding away in the dome, shying away from the Seaborn, looking out into pure waters. How could you understand what she felt? What I felt?

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: I saw what she held in her hand. The thing she 'held tight' even as the Seaborn tore her apart and devoured her.

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: You took what Anya sacrificed her life for—

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: It was an unopened vial of attractant pheromones, Pappus.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Tell me, Anya. Is the sea out there really that terrifying?

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: I... I work in the spot closest to the sea every day, but I've never seen them before.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: I only ever see the unending streams of legionnaires heading out, and you and your mentor doing your best to restore the ocean's ecology.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Sometimes, I think... What's the frontline really like? What price did you pay for the peace I see inside the dome?

steps.name: Anya
steps.text: Idiot.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Anya
steps.text: You don't need to know. It's... It's better if you don't.
Anya's eyes widen slightly as she points out into the ocean. Lucilla follows her finger, and what she sees causes her breath to catch in her throat.
Magma from the volcano is seeping out of the seafloor below the city, its radiance illuminating the reefs and organisms within them.

steps.name: Anya
steps.text: A seabed sunset. Lucky! Would've missed it if I came over late.
Lucilla can't help but lean over and look her in the eye. Anya's joy-filled gaze reflects the ocean they both so dearly love. The home of the Ægir.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: 'The Hopeful Ones.' Don't know why, but that phrase suddenly popped into my head... Oh, right! It's the name of the art exhibition coming up soon. When's it open...

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Ah, it's in two days!

steps.name: Anya
steps.text: Then I guess we know what we're doing after work that day? Let's go check out this 'Hopeful Ones' thing.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: I knew she never intended to release those pheromones. She would never lead the Seaborn to the city.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: And you... You stupid, cowardly...

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Lucilla, you know perfectly well that Milliarium could withstand an attack from this wave of Seaborn, so why would it retreat?

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Because it's not retreating. It's moving towards dry land. Ægir is set to engage in another pointless struggle—

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Oh, great, more of this nonsense!

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Let me conclude this little speech of yours for you: Wanting to escape the Seaborn? A pointless struggle. Fighting against them? Also a pointless struggle.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Was Anya saving your ass also a pointless struggle to you?! Hah! Sounds like I really did do the right thing!

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Just stop this. Even if you do drown me here, it won't prove either of us right, and it'll be of no benefit for the future...

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Do... Do you really intend to go through with this, Lucilla?

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: Very well. If that is the future you believe in—
Pappus's voice is cut off by a furious slam on the other side of the call.

steps.name: Sea Patroller
steps.text: We've found Lucilla by an entry to the city's inner circulatory pipes. No sign of Pappus.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: Teams two and three, search for Pappus. Team one, with me!

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: Don't move, Lucilla.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Huh, this is the first time I've ever been pointed at like this.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: Where's Pappus?

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Don't know. I'm not the head of the Institute of Incubation, so don't bother asking me about missing children, okay?

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: He's an important lead. He can't die yet. He's in the pipes, right? Where exactly?

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Seems you Sea Patrollers also love talking to yourselves and not listening.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: There's a rage in you. I've seen it plenty of times in these sorts of cases. A fury in the eyes of the victim's friends and family that cannot be quenched.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: You don't have much time left. Five minutes have passed since you arrived here. If he truly is somewhere in the pipes, he should be reaching his limits about now.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Don't you think that drowning in a sewage pipe is a fitting way for him to go?

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: Tell us where he is, now.

steps.name: Sea Patroller
steps.text: Suspect Pappus has been found! First aid robot requested!
In the distance, Pappus, reeking from head to toe, lies flat on the ground. Deathly pale and motionless.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: Let me see. He's...

steps.name: Pappus
steps.text: *cough*...

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: Still alive—

steps.name: Sea Patroller
steps.text: Luckily the pipe was not closed here; it let some fresh air inside. Nearly unconscious by the time we found him, but he was still trying to crawl out of there.
Upon hearing that the pipe was left open, the Sea Patrol captain realizes something. He turns to Lucilla. A bitter, self-mocking smile flashes across her face, tears swelling up in her eyes.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Guess I couldn't do it after all. I couldn't go against her final wish. The one she sacrificed her life to save... Hmph.

steps.name: Sea Patrol Captain
steps.text: Once again, you made the right choice. I hope it came from the heart.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Relax. Sorry to say, but there's no fallen dome maintenance worker for you to execute here.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: For causing you guys so much trouble, I'll accept whatever punishment you see fit. Keep it quick, though. I have an exhibition to visit later.

steps.name: Lucilla
steps.text: Even though the one I wanted to go with isn't here anymore, I promised her I'd go and see them. The ones who hold onto hope.
Lucilla walks towards the Sea Patrol ship, her relief clear on her face, and a spring in her step. She looks down at her hand, clasped as though it is being held by a familiar grasp.
